newsitem.title: USA: Small firms focus of U.S. trade trip to Canada.
newsitem.headline: Small firms focus of U.S. trade trip to Canada.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of Commerce William Daley said on Thursday he will lead a delegation of small and medium-sized firms on a three-day trade mission to Canada.

"The focus on small business is a result of the fact that's where the growth of our economy is," Daley said. "Fifty percent of jobs in America today are in businesses that are defined as small and medium sized."
Representatives of 16 companies will accompany the secretary August 3-6 on the trip that will take themto Montreal, Ottawa and Toronto.
Daley said Canada was chosen for the missions because of the ease of language and transportation and because tariffs on goods will be eliminated as of January 1.
Canada is also the United States' top trading partner with more than $370 billion in two-way trade year.
Information and environmental technologies trade will highlight the mission, he said.
